beforeWhole.title: Planare chromatografische Trennungen durchführen und auswerten
beforeWhole.titleEn: Perform and interpret planar chromatographic separations
beforeWhole.description: Die lernende Person kann eine geeignete planare chromatografische Trennung durchführen, stationäre Phase und Laufmittel begründet auswählen, Startlinie, Laufmittelfront und eigene Rohdaten dokumentieren sowie Chromatogramme und Rf-Werte unter gleichen Methodenbedingungen mit Referenzen vergleichen, um Gemischbestandteile vorläufig zuzuordnen und die Grenzen dieser Zuordnung zu erläutern.
beforeWhole.descriptionEn: The learner can perform an appropriate planar chromatographic separation, justify the stationary phase and solvent, document the origin, solvent front and their own raw data, and compare chromatograms and Rf values with references under matched method conditions to provisionally assign mixture components and explain the limits of that assignment.

sourceRoleClarification.planarPerformance: Actual appropriate planar performance and its documented interpretation form this whole goal. Paper/TLC and substance domains are source-selected routes; they are not cumulative universal duties.
sourceRoleClarification.GCSeparateContribution: Carrier-gas principle and retention-time interpretation belong to the separately authored GC goal; no GC-instrument execution is demanded by either source correction.
sourceRoleClarification.HBPartialBoundary: HB p27 explanation and Rf interpretation are a partial contribution. They do not alone prove the additional canonical practical-performance claim.

authorRationale.oldProblem: Explaining the biodiesel process was made to require the stronger whole LK competence of independently planning transesterifications/equilibria. This hides an LK planning obligation inside some GK-source explanation routes.
authorRationale.actualNeed: Existing vegetable-oil/triglyceride structure plus ester formation, reversible ester reactions and the distinction between acidic/alkaline hydrolysis are the appropriate concrete prior concepts. The complete biodiesel P cases themselves teach the exchanged alcohol residue, 1:3:3:1 balance, free-acid/base interference and source-bounded sustainability.
authorRationale.preserved: Independent biodiesel explanation, all current DE/EN P cases, genuine national source/course differences and LK transesterification-planning goal remain unchanged; no actual synthesis or approval claimed.
